Forecast trend plot (age-averaged, by group)

Source: R/plotting.R
plot_forecast_trends.Rd

Forecast trend plot (age-averaged, by group)

Usage

plot_forecast_trends(
  obs_dt,
  fitted_dt,
  fc_dt,
  output_dir,
  cause_label,
  cause_short,
  forecast_years,
  group_cols = character(0),
  smooth_dt = NULL
)

Arguments

obs_dt

Observed data.table with mx_obs.

fitted_dt

Fitted data.table with mx_fitted.

fc_dt

Forecast data.table with mx_adjusted, mx_lo95_adj, mx_hi95_adj.

output_dir

Output directory path.

cause_label

Full cause name.

cause_short

Short cause key.

forecast_years

Integer vector of forecast years.

group_cols

Character vector of group column names in the data.tables.

smooth_dt

Optional data.table with mx_lo95, mx_hi95 for Bayesian CI ribbon.
